question: When is the I/START application due?
expected: It uses NIH standard due dates over multiple cycles: new applications February 16, June 16 and October 16, and resubmission applications March 16, July 16 and November 16 (2025 through 2027), all by 5:00 PM local time of the applicant organization; the notice expires January 08, 2028.
quote: All applications are due by 5:00 PM local time of applicant organization.

question: How much money can I ask for?
expected: Up to $150,000 in direct costs for a single year; the maximum project period is 1 year.
quote: Applicants may request direct costs of up to $150,000 for a period of one year only.

question: Can I put my publications in the appendix?
expected: No. Only limited Appendix materials are allowed, and no publications or other material may be included except blank questionnaires or blank surveys.
